cases.name: An SDLC run's event starts the watcher; a failing check is fixed, reviewed and pushed with no person involved
Checks still fail after the repair limit, so a person decides and stops the watcher
An SDLC run that opened no pull request ends the watcher quietly
A setup error and the end of the watch window each ask a person
A trusted comment needs no change after a failed checkout; the watcher keeps watching until the pull request closes
A fixer that cannot fix a revised change, a failed review, a blocked review and a rejected push each ask a person
